notes.title: Language Issue in Chapter 12 and 13 Patch
notes.content:
Happy 2023! We’ve been excited to be part of several events this year including Steam Puzzle Fest, Steam Visual Novel Fest and Gradient Convergence presented by [url=https://www.gamedevsofcolorexpo.com/]Game Devs of Color Expo[/url]! Hello to any new friends out there!

For the PC version, we’ve fixed a language issue in Chapter 12 and 13 regarding Big O Notation. Thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197998219694/]Vertani[/url] for pointing it out!

If anyone else notices something we should fix, you can always contact us at  [url=https://prettysmartgames.com/contact]https://prettysmartgames.com/contact[/url] or join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/nrTTyjj]https://discord.gg/nrTTyjj[/url]

And thank you to those of you that have already mentioned things here on Steam, we appreciate you bringing them up even if we can’t fix them yet!

notes.title: Happy 2 Year Launch Anniversary!
notes.content:
It's been two years since we launched Code Romantic! Thank you so much for all the feedback and time spent playing our coding visual novel.

We have some updates, but the biggest one is that Code Romantic is now playable on Mac!
Please let us know if you find any bugs or have any issues so we can remedy them so you can continue enjoying your Mac gaming experience.

Our other update is that Code Romantic: Part 2 is in the works and we have new key art to share with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33181728/c53502b471509626512f5e74408eaa90320d8bac.jpg[/img]

We do not have an official announce date yet, but we are making lots of progress on finishing the story and working with our lovely illustrator, [url=https://allysonkelley.com/]Allyson Kelley[/url], on key moments and sketches. 
Code Romantic: Part 2 Steam page and announce trailer are coming soon!

If you have any support questions, please reach out to us at [url=mailto:info@prettysmartgames.com]info@prettysmartgames.com[/url] or post in the forum so we can address any issues.

Consider becoming a patron to support our indie game dev studio! We will be posting more exclusive behind the scenes information and in progress shots of Code Romantic: Part 2 on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/prettysmartgames]Patreon[/url].

notes.title: Update notes for 2.3.0!
notes.content:
Happy 1 year anniversary! We updated the save system and made some improvements. Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Cloud saves: your save slots will now migrate between computers!

[*] Save checkpoints: Your progress is now saved several times in longer chapters. Look for a save disk icon in the upper right corner!

[*] Added a disclaimer: just in case you weren't sure, this is a fictional story!

[*] Typos and animation bugs fixed!
[/list]
